summary: Updated the programmatic flashlight Rerun stream so camera pose, frustum, RGB projection, depth, normal visualization, diffuse visualization, camera trajectory, and light direction are logged in a coherent right-handed Z-up Rerun world under the intended entity paths. README text was updated for the user-visible Rerun paths and visualization behavior.
work_completed: Added Unreal/SPEAR-to-Rerun world conversion for camera locations and vectors, mapping Unreal X-forward/Y-right/Z-up into Rerun X-right/Y-forward/Z-up and scaling Unreal centimeters to Rerun meters.

Logged `spear/camera` with a `Transform3D` camera-to-world matrix using RDF camera basis columns and a `Pinhole` with `camera_xyz=rr.ViewCoordinates.RDF`, visible frustum styling, and `image_plane_distance`.

Made image color handling explicit: final tone curve BGR/BGRA is converted to RGB/RGBA with explicit color model, diffuse color is gamma corrected for visualization, and world normals are logged as false-color normal visualization.
Updated terminal status output to print the converted Rerun world camera position in meters.
Updated `examples/flashlight/README.md` to describe the new Rerun paths and color/visualization behavior.
Validation passed: static Rerun smoke check verified camera image paths, `Pinhole` frustum kwargs, and removal of old `spear/images/...` paths.

findings.message: Coordinate conversion is centralized with `UNREAL_TO_RERUN_WORLD_MATRIX`; camera translations are converted from Unreal centimeters to Rerun meters, while orientation and light direction vectors are axis-converted without distance scaling.
Depth now logs at `spear/camera/depth_meters`, so Rerun can associate it with the `spear/camera` pinhole instead of treating it as a disconnected image stream.

Live simulator/Rerun end-to-end validation was not run per task constraints. The local environment also lacks installed `numpy`, `spear`, and `rerun`, so the Rerun validation was limited to py-compile plus static stub-style checks rather than constructing real Rerun archetypes.

follow_up_recommendations: Run a live SPEAR/Rerun session with the examples extra dependencies installed to visually confirm frustum scale, RGB projection placement, and depth backprojection in the viewer.
Inspector should review the centimeter-to-meter scaling choice for consistency with any downstream Rerun workflows that expected raw Unreal centimeter coordinates.
